mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for an interior finish upgrade project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation and design discussion to define your vision and material preferences. This is followed by a detailed proposal, material selection, and scheduling. Once materials are ordered, the on-site work, such as demolition and installation, commences. During this phase, clear communication with your contractor is crucial to address any questions or adjustments, ensuring the project aligns with your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, proposal, material selection, scheduling, and on-site installation. Clear communication with your contractor is key throughout.
